args.code: (() => { try { const data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('farm_game_save_v1')) || {}; const skills = data.skills || {}; const npc = data.npcAffinity || {}; const inventory = data.inventory || {}; const events = data.eventsTriggered || []; const fieldCount = data.fields ? data.fields.length : 0; const idleFields = data.fields ? data.fields.filter(f => f.stage === 'idle').length : 0; const plantedFields = data.fields ? data.fields.filter(f => f.stage === 'planted').length : 0; const result = {day: data.day, season: data.season, time: data.time, money: data.money, health: data.health, maxHealth: data.maxHealth, stamina: data.stamina, maxStamina: data.maxStamina, mode: data.mode, difficulty: data.difficulty || data.mode, gameSpeed: data.gameSpeed || 1, disasterRate: data.disasterRate, fieldCount, idleFields, plantedFields, skillsSummary: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(skills).map(([k,v]) => [k, {level: v.level, exp: v.exp}])), npcSummary: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(npc).map(([k,v]) => [k, v])), inventorySummary: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(inventory).map(([k,v]) => [k, v])), eventsCount: events.length, recentEvents: events.slice(-5), totalYield: data.totalYield, totalSold: data.totalSold, disasters: data.disasters}; return JSON.stringify(result); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
